preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to trigger Sweep() function, or marketingAddress must be a contract with gas-intensive fallback
Contract must have ETH balance to transfer

exploit_hint: The vulnerability exists in transferToAddressETH() which uses recipient.transfer(amount) with hardcoded 2300 gas limit. To exploit: 1) If attacker controls marketingAddress, deploy a contract with fallback function requiring >2300 gas. 2) Trigger swapTokens() which calls transferToAddressETH(marketingAddress, ...). 3) The transfer will fail, causing the entire transaction to revert, potentially DoSing the swap/liquidity mechanism. Alternatively, owner can call Sweep() which also uses .transfer() to send ETH to owner address.
